name: Data & Model Poisoning Assessment
description: Assessment of training pipeline integrity against data poisoning, label manipulation, and model backdoor attacks. Covers evaluating data provenance, detecting poisoned training sets, and assessing the effectiveness of data validation controls.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to data or model poisoning concepts

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands how training data manipulation can compromise model behavior
evidence: Can explain data poisoning and backdoor attack concepts
Aware of the distinction between poisoning for degradation vs. targeted backdoor insertion
Familiar with real-world poisoning incidents and their impact

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Can execute known poisoning techniques in controlled settings under guidance
evidence: Demonstrates label-flipping and clean-label poisoning in lab environments
Evaluates basic data provenance and integrity controls
Documents training pipeline vulnerabilities with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses training pipelines for poisoning vulnerabilities
evidence: Evaluates data collection, labeling, and curation processes for manipulation risk
Tests model behavior under simulated poisoning conditions
Assesses effectiveness of data validation and anomaly detection controls
Produces actionable reports on training pipeline integrity

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses complex training pipelines; designs poisoning detection strategies; mentors others
evidence: Evaluates multi-source data pipelines with federated or crowd-sourced training data
Designs detection strategies for subtle backdoor triggers
Reviews and improves training integrity assessments across the team
Develops methodology for ongoing training data monitoring

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines training integrity assessment practice; publishes research
evidence: Established the lab's training pipeline security assessment methodology
Published research on poisoning attacks, defenses, or detection techniques
Trains teams on training data integrity assessment
Contributes to external standards or industry guidance on ML data governance

assessment_methods.description: Given a training pipeline, identify injection points and demonstrate a targeted poisoning attack in a sandboxed environment
Review training pipeline assessment reports for coverage of data provenance, integrity controls, and detection gaps
